scientific_integrity: The ten-test upper bound compares exact signature-class counts. Ten exclusive obstructions and inclusion-minimal support containment give the lower bound against all choices of factors. The earlier full list of attractors is credited as prior data.
scientific_limitations: The minimum is for conjunctions of individual factor-hit predicates on three-position candidates of the tenth Tribonacci iterate only. No infinite-stage or general decision-complexity result is asserted.
title: A sharp ten-factor test for three-position attractors of the tenth Tribonacci word
